title: ctaudit / ELB report
description: The ctaudit ELB HTML report rebuilt from the request and conn lines ctaudit ships to Loki (--loki, or serve elb). Tables count every line in the time range; Loki stores lines at ship time, so the range must cover the scan runs, not the request times.

list.name: client_ip
list.label: Client IP (regex)
list.description: Regular expression on the client IP.

list.name: status
list.label: ELB status (regex)
list.description: Regular expression on the ELB status, for example 5..

list.name: fail_status
list.label: Failing status
list.description: Which ELB statuses the Failing requests section counts.

panels.title: Requests

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="elb", kind="request", lb=~"$lb"} | json client_ip="client_ip", elb_status="elb_status" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | elb_status=~"$status" [$__range]))

panels.description: Access log requests in the time range that match the job, load balancer, client IP, and status filters. Follows the dashboard filters.

panels.title: Received

targets.expr: sum(sum_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="elb", kind="request", lb=~"$lb"} | json received_bytes="received_bytes", client_ip="client_ip", elb_status="elb_status" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | elb_status=~"$status" | received_bytes!="" | keep received_bytes | unwrap received_bytes | __error__="" [$__range]))

panels.description: Bytes the load balancer received from clients for the matching requests. Follows the dashboard filters.

panels.title: Sent

targets.expr: sum(sum_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="elb", kind="request", lb=~"$lb"} | json sent_bytes="sent_bytes", client_ip="client_ip", elb_status="elb_status" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | elb_status=~"$status" | sent_bytes!="" | keep sent_bytes | unwrap sent_bytes | __error__="" [$__range]))

panels.description: Bytes the load balancer sent back to clients for the matching requests. Follows the dashboard filters.

panels.title: 4xx

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="elb", kind="request", lb=~"$lb"} | json client_ip="client_ip", elb_status="elb_status" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | elb_status=~"$status" | elb_status=~"4.." [$__range]))

panels.description: Requests whose ELB status is 4xx.

panels.title: 5xx

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="elb", kind="request", lb=~"$lb"} | json client_ip="client_ip", elb_status="elb_status" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | elb_status=~"$status" | elb_status=~"5.." [$__range]))

panels.description: Requests whose ELB status is 5xx.

panels.title: Latency avg

targets.expr: avg_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="elb", kind="request", lb=~"$lb"} | json latency="latency", client_ip="client_ip", elb_status="elb_status" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | elb_status=~"$status" | latency!="" | keep latency | unwrap latency | __error__="" [$__range]) by ()

panels.description: request_time + target_time + response_time. Requests with an unknown latency are left out.

panels.title: Latency max

targets.expr: max_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="elb", kind="request", lb=~"$lb"} | json latency="latency", client_ip="client_ip", elb_status="elb_status" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | elb_status=~"$status" | latency!="" | keep latency | unwrap latency | __error__="" [$__range]) by ()

panels.description: Highest total latency (request_time + target_time + response_time) of a matching request. Follows the dashboard filters.

panels.title: Load balancers

targets.expr: count(sum by (lb) (count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="elb", kind="request", lb=~"$lb"} | json client_ip="client_ip", elb_status="elb_status" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | elb_status=~"$status" [$__range])))

panels.description: Distinct load balancers that served matching requests. Follows the dashboard filters.

panels.title: Requests by load balancer

targets.expr: sum by (lb) (count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="elb", kind="request", lb=~"$lb"} | json client_ip="client_ip", elb_status="elb_status" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | elb_status=~"$status" [$__interval]))

panels.description: Lines shipped with --loki-time event (the serve default) are stored at the request time, so the time range selects requests. Lines shipped with --loki-time scan are stored at the scan time; the real request time is the event_time column.

panels.title: Requests by ELB status class

targets.expr: sum by (class) (count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="elb", kind="request", lb=~"$lb"} | json client_ip="client_ip", elb_status="elb_status" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | elb_status=~"$status" | label_format class=`{{ substr 0 1 .elb_status }}xx` [$__interval]))

panels.description: Lines shipped with --loki-time event (the serve default) are stored at the request time, so the time range selects requests. Lines shipped with --loki-time scan are stored at the scan time; the real request time is the event_time column.

panels.title: Target response time (avg)

targets.expr: avg_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="elb", kind="request", lb=~"$lb"} | json target_time="target_time", client_ip="client_ip", elb_status="elb_status" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | elb_status=~"$status" | target_time!="" | keep target_time | unwrap target_time | __error__="" [$__range]) by ()

panels.description: Mean target_time of requests a target answered. Warn 500 ms, critical 1 s.

panels.title: 5xx rate

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="elb", kind="request", lb=~"$lb"} | json client_ip="client_ip", elb_status="elb_status" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | elb_status=~"$status" | elb_status=~"5.." [$__range])) / sum(count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="elb", kind="request", lb=~"$lb"} | json client_ip="client_ip", elb_status="elb_status" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | elb_status=~"$status" [$__range]))

panels.description: Share of requests with an ELB 5xx. Warn 1%, critical 5%.

panels.title: Target connection errors

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="elb", kind="request", lb=~"$lb"} | json error_reason="error_reason", target="target", target_status="target_status", client_ip="client_ip", elb_status="elb_status" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | elb_status=~"$status" | error_reason=~"TargetConnection.*" or (elb_status="502" and target!="" and target_status="") [$__range]))

panels.description: A TargetConnection* error reason, or a 502 with a target and no target status.

panels.title: Targets returning 5xx

targets.expr: count(sum by (target) (count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="elb", kind="request", lb=~"$lb"} | json target="target", target_status="target_status", client_ip="client_ip", elb_status="elb_status" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | elb_status=~"$status" | target_status=~"5.." | target!="" | keep target [$__range])))

panels.description: Distinct targets that answered with a 5xx. Access logs carry no health checks, so this stands in for the unhealthy host count.

panels.title: Requests and target response time

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="elb", kind="request", lb=~"$lb"} | json client_ip="client_ip", elb_status="elb_status" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | elb_status=~"$status" [$__interval]))

avg(avg_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="elb", kind="request", lb=~"$lb"} | json target_time="target_time", client_ip="client_ip", elb_status="elb_status" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | elb_status=~"$status" | target_time!="" | keep target_time | unwrap target_time | __error__="" [$__interval])) by ()

panels.description: Lines shipped with --loki-time event (the serve default) are stored at the request time, so the time range selects requests. Lines shipped with --loki-time scan are stored at the scan time; the real request time is the event_time column.

panels.title: Target responses

targets.expr: sum by (tclass) (count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="elb", kind="request", lb=~"$lb"} | json target_status="target_status", client_ip="client_ip", elb_status="elb_status" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | elb_status=~"$status" | label_format tclass=`{{ if .target_status }}{{ substr 0 1 .target_status }}xx{{ else }}no target response{{ end }}` | keep tclass [$__interval]))

sum(count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="elb", kind="request", lb=~"$lb"} | json error_reason="error_reason", target="target", target_status="target_status", client_ip="client_ip", elb_status="elb_status" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | elb_status=~"$status" | error_reason=~"TargetConnection.*" or (elb_status="502" and target!="" and target_status="") [$__interval]))

panels.description: Lines shipped with --loki-time event (the serve default) are stored at the request time, so the time range selects requests. Lines shipped with --loki-time scan are stored at the scan time; the real request time is the event_time column.

panels.title: Latency

targets.expr: avg(avg_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="elb", kind="request", lb=~"$lb"} | json latency="latency", client_ip="client_ip", elb_status="elb_status" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | elb_status=~"$status" | latency!="" | keep latency | unwrap latency | __error__="" [$__interval])) by ()

max(max_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="elb", kind="request", lb=~"$lb"} | json latency="latency", client_ip="client_ip", elb_status="elb_status" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | elb_status=~"$status" | latency!="" | keep latency | unwrap latency | __error__="" [$__interval])) by ()

avg(avg_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="elb", kind="request", lb=~"$lb"} | json target_time="target_time", client_ip="client_ip", elb_status="elb_status" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | elb_status=~"$status" | target_time!="" | keep target_time | unwrap target_time | __error__="" [$__interval])) by ()

panels.description: Dashed lines mark 500 ms and 1 s. Lines shipped with --loki-time event (the serve default) are stored at the request time, so the time range selects requests. Lines shipped with --loki-time scan are stored at the scan time; the real request time is the event_time column.

panels.title: Average latency of the slowest paths

targets.expr: topk(5, avg by (path) (avg_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="elb", kind="request", lb=~"$lb"} | json path="path", latency="latency", client_ip="client_ip", elb_status="elb_status" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | elb_status=~"$status" | label_format path=`{{ regexReplaceAll "/[0-9]+([./]|$)" (regexReplaceAll "/[0-9]+([./]|$)" .path "/{n}${1}") "/{n}${1}" }}` | latency!="" | keep path, latency | unwrap latency | __error__="" [$__interval])))

panels.description: Numeric path segments become {n}. Lines shipped with --loki-time event (the serve default) are stored at the request time, so the time range selects requests. Lines shipped with --loki-time scan are stored at the scan time; the real request time is the event_time column.

panels.title: ELB status class

targets.expr: sum by (class) (count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="elb", kind="request", lb=~"$lb"} | json client_ip="client_ip", elb_status="elb_status" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | elb_status=~"$status" | label_format class=`{{ substr 0 1 .elb_status }}xx` | keep class [$__range]))

panels.description: Share of matching requests by ELB status class (2xx, 3xx, 4xx, 5xx). Follows the dashboard filters.

panels.title: Load balancer

targets.expr: sum by (lb) (count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="elb", kind="request", lb=~"$lb"} | json client_ip="client_ip", elb_status="elb_status" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | elb_status=~"$status" | keep lb [$__range]))

panels.description: Share of matching requests served by each load balancer. Follows the dashboard filters.

panels.title: Method

targets.expr: topk(6, sum by (method) (count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="elb", kind="request", lb=~"$lb"} | json method="method", client_ip="client_ip", elb_status="elb_status" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | elb_status=~"$status" | method!="" | keep method [$__range])))

panels.description: Share of matching requests by HTTP method; the six most used methods. Follows the dashboard filters.

panels.title: Listener type

targets.expr: sum by (type) (count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="elb", kind="request", lb=~"$lb"} | json type="type", client_ip="client_ip", elb_status="elb_status" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | elb_status=~"$status" | type!="" | keep type [$__range]))

panels.description: Share of matching requests by listener type (http, https, h2, grpcs, ws, wss, tcp, tls). Follows the dashboard filters.

panels.title: Target groups

targets.expr: topk($top, sum by (tg) (count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="elb", kind="request", lb=~"$lb"} | json target_group_arn="target_group_arn", client_ip="client_ip", elb_status="elb_status" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | elb_status=~"$status" | target_group_arn!="" | label_format tg=`{{ regexReplaceAll ".*:targetgroup/" .target_group_arn "" }}` | keep tg [$__range])))

sum by (tg) (count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="elb", kind="request", lb=~"$lb"} | json target_group_arn="target_group_arn", target_status="target_status", client_ip="client_ip", elb_status="elb_status" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | elb_status=~"$status" | target_group_arn!="" | label_format tg=`{{ regexReplaceAll ".*:targetgroup/" .target_group_arn "" }}` | target_status=~"2.." | keep tg [$__range]))

sum by (tg) (count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="elb", kind="request", lb=~"$lb"} | json target_group_arn="target_group_arn", target_status="target_status", client_ip="client_ip", elb_status="elb_status" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | elb_status=~"$status" | target_group_arn!="" | label_format tg=`{{ regexReplaceAll ".*:targetgroup/" .target_group_arn "" }}` | target_status=~"4.." | keep tg [$__range]))

sum by (tg) (count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="elb", kind="request", lb=~"$lb"} | json target_group_arn="target_group_arn", target_status="target_status", client_ip="client_ip", elb_status="elb_status" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | elb_status=~"$status" | target_group_arn!="" | label_format tg=`{{ regexReplaceAll ".*:targetgroup/" .target_group_arn "" }}` | target_status=~"5.." | keep tg [$__range]))

sum by (tg) (count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="elb", kind="request", lb=~"$lb"} | json target_group_arn="target_group_arn", client_ip="client_ip", elb_status="elb_status" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | elb_status=~"$status" | target_group_arn!="" | label_format tg=`{{ regexReplaceAll ".*:targetgroup/" .target_group_arn "" }}` | elb_status=~"5.." | keep tg [$__range]))

sum by (tg) (count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="elb", kind="request", lb=~"$lb"} | json target_group_arn="target_group_arn", error_reason="error_reason", target="target", target_status="target_status", client_ip="client_ip", elb_status="elb_status" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | elb_status=~"$status" | target_group_arn!="" | label_format tg=`{{ regexReplaceAll ".*:targetgroup/" .target_group_arn "" }}` | error_reason=~"TargetConnection.*" or (elb_status="502" and target!="" and target_status="") | keep tg [$__range]))

count by (tg) (sum by (tg, target) (count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="elb", kind="request", lb=~"$lb"} | json target_group_arn="target_group_arn", target="target", client_ip="client_ip", elb_status="elb_status" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | elb_status=~"$status" | target_group_arn!="" | label_format tg=`{{ regexReplaceAll ".*:targetgroup/" .target_group_arn "" }}` | target!="" | keep tg, target [$__range])))

avg_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="elb", kind="request", lb=~"$lb"} | json target_group_arn="target_group_arn", target_time="target_time", client_ip="client_ip", elb_status="elb_status" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | elb_status=~"$status" | target_group_arn!="" | label_format tg=`{{ regexReplaceAll ".*:targetgroup/" .target_group_arn "" }}` | target_time!="" | keep tg, target_time | unwrap target_time | __error__="" [$__range]) by (tg)

max_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="elb", kind="request", lb=~"$lb"} | json target_group_arn="target_group_arn", target_time="target_time", client_ip="client_ip", elb_status="elb_status" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | elb_status=~"$status" | target_group_arn!="" | label_format tg=`{{ regexReplaceAll ".*:targetgroup/" .target_group_arn "" }}` | target_time!="" | keep tg, target_time | unwrap target_time | __error__="" [$__range]) by (tg)

min_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="elb", kind="request", lb=~"$lb"} | json path="path", latency="latency", client_ip="client_ip", elb_status="elb_status" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | elb_status=~"$status" | label_format path=`{{ regexReplaceAll "/[0-9]+([./]|$)" (regexReplaceAll "/[0-9]+([./]|$)" .path "/{n}${1}") "/{n}${1}" }}` | latency!="" | keep path, latency | unwrap latency | __error__="" [$__range]) by (path)

max_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="elb", kind="request", lb=~"$lb"} | json path="path", latency="latency", client_ip="client_ip", elb_status="elb_status" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | elb_status=~"$status" | label_format path=`{{ regexReplaceAll "/[0-9]+([./]|$)" (regexReplaceAll "/[0-9]+([./]|$)" .path "/{n}${1}") "/{n}${1}" }}` | latency!="" | keep path, latency | unwrap latency | __error__="" [$__range]) by (path)

sum by (path) (count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="elb", kind="request", lb=~"$lb"} | json path="path", latency="latency", client_ip="client_ip", elb_status="elb_status" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | elb_status=~"$status" | label_format path=`{{ regexReplaceAll "/[0-9]+([./]|$)" (regexReplaceAll "/[0-9]+([./]|$)" .path "/{n}${1}") "/{n}${1}" }}` | latency!="" | keep path [$__range]))

panels.description: Client IPs that received the most failing responses. Follows the dashboard filters.

panels.title: Failing by target

targets.expr: topk($top, sum by (target) (count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="elb", kind="request", lb=~"$lb"} | json target="target", client_ip="client_ip", elb_status="elb_status" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | elb_status=~"$status" | elb_status=~"$fail_status" | target!="" | keep target [$__range])))

panels.description: Targets (IP:port) behind the most failing requests. Empty when no target was chosen. Follows the dashboard filters.

panels.title: Failing by error reason

targets.expr: topk($top, sum by (error_reason) (count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="elb", kind="request", lb=~"$lb"} | json error_reason="error_reason", client_ip="client_ip", elb_status="elb_status" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | elb_status=~"$status" | elb_status=~"$fail_status" | error_reason!="" | keep error_reason [$__range])))

panels.description: ALB error_reason of failing requests, such as TargetConnectionErrorCode or TargetTimeout. Follows the dashboard filters.

panels.title: Failing by load balancer

targets.expr: topk($top, sum by (lb) (count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="elb", kind="request", lb=~"$lb"} | json client_ip="client_ip", elb_status="elb_status" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | elb_status=~"$status" | elb_status=~"$fail_status" | keep lb [$__range])))

panels.description: Load balancers that returned the most failing responses. Follows the dashboard filters.

panels.title: Failing requests (newest 500 lines)

targets.expr: {job=~"$job", subcommand="elb", kind="request", lb=~"$lb"} | json client_ip="client_ip", elb_status="elb_status" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | elb_status=~"$status" | elb_status=~"$fail_status"

panels.description: Lines shipped with --loki-time event (the serve default) are stored at the request time, so the time range selects requests. Lines shipped with --loki-time scan are stored at the scan time; the real request time is the event_time column.

panels.title: By load balancer

targets.expr: topk($top, sum by (lb) (count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="elb", kind="request", lb=~"$lb"} | json client_ip="client_ip", elb_status="elb_status" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | elb_status=~"$status" | keep lb [$__range])))

panels.description: Matching requests per load balancer. Follows the dashboard filters.

panels.title: By ELB status

targets.expr: topk($top, sum by (elb_status) (count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="elb", kind="request", lb=~"$lb"} | json client_ip="client_ip", elb_status="elb_status" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | elb_status=~"$status" | elb_status!="" | keep elb_status [$__range])))

panels.description: Matching requests by the status code the load balancer returned to the client. Follows the dashboard filters.

panels.title: By target status

targets.expr: topk($top, sum by (target_status) (count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="elb", kind="request", lb=~"$lb"} | json target_status="target_status", client_ip="client_ip", elb_status="elb_status" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | elb_status=~"$status" | target_status!="" | keep target_status [$__range])))

panels.description: Matching requests by the status code the target returned. Missing when no target answered. Follows the dashboard filters.

panels.title: Top client IPs

targets.expr: topk($top, sum by (client_ip) (count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="elb", kind="request", lb=~"$lb"} | json client_ip="client_ip", elb_status="elb_status" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | elb_status=~"$status" | client_ip!="" | keep client_ip [$__range])))

panels.description: Client IPs that sent the most matching requests. Follows the dashboard filters.

panels.title: Top hosts

targets.expr: topk($top, sum by (host) (count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="elb", kind="request", lb=~"$lb"} | json host="host", domain_name="domain_name", client_ip="client_ip", elb_status="elb_status" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | elb_status=~"$status" | label_format host=`{{ if .host }}{{ .host }}{{ else }}{{ .domain_name }}{{ end }}` | host!="" | keep host [$__range])))

panels.description: Host header of matching requests, or the TLS SNI domain when the host is missing. Follows the dashboard filters.

panels.title: Top paths

targets.expr: topk($top, sum by (path) (count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="elb", kind="request", lb=~"$lb"} | json path="path", client_ip="client_ip", elb_status="elb_status" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | elb_status=~"$status" | label_format path=`{{ regexReplaceAll "/[0-9]+([./]|$)" (regexReplaceAll "/[0-9]+([./]|$)" .path "/{n}${1}") "/{n}${1}" }}` | path!="" | keep path [$__range])))

panels.description: Most requested paths. Numeric path segments become {n} so IDs group together. Follows the dashboard filters.

panels.title: Top user agents

targets.expr: topk($top, sum by (user_agent) (count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="elb", kind="request", lb=~"$lb"} | json user_agent="user_agent", client_ip="client_ip", elb_status="elb_status" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | elb_status=~"$status" | user_agent!="" | keep user_agent [$__range])))

panels.description: User-Agent headers that sent the most matching requests. Follows the dashboard filters.

panels.title: Top targets

targets.expr: topk($top, sum by (target) (count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="elb", kind="request", lb=~"$lb"} | json target="target", client_ip="client_ip", elb_status="elb_status" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | elb_status=~"$status" | target!="" | keep target [$__range])))

panels.description: Targets (IP:port) that received the most matching requests. Follows the dashboard filters.

panels.title: By method

targets.expr: topk($top, sum by (method) (count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="elb", kind="request", lb=~"$lb"} | json method="method", client_ip="client_ip", elb_status="elb_status" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | elb_status=~"$status" | method!="" | keep method [$__range])))

panels.description: Matching requests by HTTP method. Follows the dashboard filters.

panels.title: By listener type

targets.expr: topk($top, sum by (type) (count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="elb", kind="request", lb=~"$lb"} | json type="type", client_ip="client_ip", elb_status="elb_status" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | elb_status=~"$status" | type!="" | keep type [$__range])))

panels.description: Matching requests by listener type (http, https, h2, grpcs, ws, wss). Follows the dashboard filters.

panels.title: By action

targets.expr: topk($top, sum by (actions) (count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="elb", kind="request", lb=~"$lb"} | json actions="actions", client_ip="client_ip", elb_status="elb_status" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | elb_status=~"$status" | actions!="" | keep actions [$__range])))

panels.description: Matching requests by the listener rule actions taken, such as forward, redirect, or fixed-response. Follows the dashboard filters.

panels.title: By TLS protocol

targets.expr: topk($top, sum by (ssl_protocol) (count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="elb", kind="request", lb=~"$lb"} | json ssl_protocol="ssl_protocol", client_ip="client_ip", elb_status="elb_status" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | elb_status=~"$status" | ssl_protocol!="" | keep ssl_protocol [$__range])))

panels.description: Matching requests by negotiated TLS protocol. TLSv1 and TLSv1.1 are weak. Follows the dashboard filters.

panels.title: By TLS cipher

targets.expr: topk($top, sum by (ssl_cipher) (count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="elb", kind="request", lb=~"$lb"} | json ssl_cipher="ssl_cipher", client_ip="client_ip", elb_status="elb_status" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | elb_status=~"$status" | ssl_cipher!="" | keep ssl_cipher [$__range])))

panels.description: Matching requests by negotiated TLS cipher suite. Follows the dashboard filters.

panels.title: Top error reasons

targets.expr: topk($top, sum by (error_reason) (count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="elb", kind="request", lb=~"$lb"} | json error_reason="error_reason", client_ip="client_ip", elb_status="elb_status" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | elb_status=~"$status" | error_reason!="" | keep error_reason [$__range])))

panels.description: ALB error_reason values of matching requests. Follows the dashboard filters.

panels.title: Top classifications

targets.expr: topk($top, sum by (classification) (count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="elb", kind="request", lb=~"$lb"} | json classification="classification", client_ip="client_ip", elb_status="elb_status" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | elb_status=~"$status" | classification!="" | keep classification [$__range])))

panels.description: HTTP desync mitigation classification (Acceptable, Ambiguous, Severe) of matching requests. Follows the dashboard filters.

panels.title: Connections

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="elb", kind="conn", lb=~"$lb"} | json client_ip="client_ip" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" [$__range]))

panels.description: ALB connection log records (conn_log_*) that match the job, load balancer, and client IP filters. Follows the dashboard filters.

panels.title: TLS

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="elb", kind="conn", lb=~"$lb"} | json ssl_protocol="ssl_protocol", client_ip="client_ip" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | ssl_protocol!="" [$__range]))

panels.description: Connections that negotiated a TLS protocol.

panels.title: Failed handshakes (443)

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="elb", kind="conn", lb=~"$lb"} | json listener="listener", ssl_protocol="ssl_protocol", client_ip="client_ip" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | listener="443" | ssl_protocol="" [$__range]))

panels.description: Connections on listener 443 with no TLS protocol.

panels.title: Handshake avg

targets.expr: avg_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="elb", kind="conn", lb=~"$lb"} | json tls_handshake_time="tls_handshake_time", client_ip="client_ip" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | tls_handshake_time!="" | keep tls_handshake_time | unwrap tls_handshake_time | __error__="" [$__range]) by ()

panels.description: Mean TLS handshake time of matching connections. Connections with an unknown time are left out. Follows the dashboard filters.

panels.title: Handshake max

targets.expr: max_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="elb", kind="conn", lb=~"$lb"} | json tls_handshake_time="tls_handshake_time", client_ip="client_ip" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | tls_handshake_time!="" | keep tls_handshake_time | unwrap tls_handshake_time | __error__="" [$__range]) by ()

panels.description: Longest TLS handshake time of a matching connection. Follows the dashboard filters.

panels.title: Load balancers

targets.expr: count(sum by (lb) (count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="elb", kind="conn", lb=~"$lb"} | json client_ip="client_ip" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" [$__range])))

panels.description: Distinct load balancers with matching connection log records. Follows the dashboard filters.

panels.title: Connections by load balancer

targets.expr: topk($top, sum by (lb) (count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="elb", kind="conn", lb=~"$lb"} | json client_ip="client_ip" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | keep lb [$__range])))

panels.description: Matching connections per load balancer. Follows the dashboard filters.

panels.title: By listener and TLS

targets.expr: topk($top, sum by (listener_tls) (count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="elb", kind="conn", lb=~"$lb"} | json listener="listener", ssl_protocol="ssl_protocol", client_ip="client_ip" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | label_format listener_tls=`{{ .listener }} {{ if .ssl_protocol }}{{ .ssl_protocol }}{{ else }}no TLS{{ end }}` | listener_tls!="" | keep listener_tls [$__range])))

panels.description: Connections by listener port and negotiated TLS protocol; no TLS on 443 means the handshake failed. Follows the dashboard filters.

panels.title: By TLS protocol

targets.expr: topk($top, sum by (ssl_protocol) (count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="elb", kind="conn", lb=~"$lb"} | json ssl_protocol="ssl_protocol", client_ip="client_ip" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | ssl_protocol!="" | keep ssl_protocol [$__range])))

panels.description: Connections by negotiated TLS protocol. TLSv1 and TLSv1.1 are weak. Follows the dashboard filters.

panels.title: By TLS cipher

targets.expr: topk($top, sum by (ssl_cipher) (count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="elb", kind="conn", lb=~"$lb"} | json ssl_cipher="ssl_cipher", client_ip="client_ip" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | ssl_cipher!="" | keep ssl_cipher [$__range])))

panels.description: Connections by negotiated TLS cipher suite. Follows the dashboard filters.

panels.title: By key exchange

targets.expr: topk($top, sum by (tls_key_exchange) (count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="elb", kind="conn", lb=~"$lb"} | json tls_key_exchange="tls_key_exchange", client_ip="client_ip" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | tls_key_exchange!="" | keep tls_key_exchange [$__range])))

panels.description: Connections by TLS key exchange group, such as X25519 or P-256. Follows the dashboard filters.

panels.title: By verify status

targets.expr: topk($top, sum by (tls_verify_status) (count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="elb", kind="conn", lb=~"$lb"} | json tls_verify_status="tls_verify_status", client_ip="client_ip" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | tls_verify_status!="" | keep tls_verify_status [$__range])))

panels.description: Client certificate verify status (mTLS). Anything but Success means the client certificate was refused. Follows the dashboard filters.

panels.title: Top client IPs

targets.expr: topk($top, sum by (client_ip) (count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="elb", kind="conn", lb=~"$lb"} | json client_ip="client_ip" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | client_ip!="" | keep client_ip [$__range])))

panels.description: Client IPs that opened the most matching connections. Follows the dashboard filters.

panels.title: Top failed-handshake client IPs

targets.expr: topk($top, sum by (client_ip) (count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="elb", kind="conn", lb=~"$lb"} | json listener="listener", ssl_protocol="ssl_protocol", client_ip="client_ip" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | listener="443" | ssl_protocol="" | client_ip!="" | keep client_ip [$__range])))

panels.description: Client IPs whose connections on listener 443 ended with no TLS protocol, a failed handshake. Follows the dashboard filters.

panels.title: By incoming TLS alert

targets.expr: topk($top, sum by (incoming_tls_alert) (count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="elb", kind="conn", lb=~"$lb"} | json incoming_tls_alert="incoming_tls_alert", client_ip="client_ip" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | incoming_tls_alert!="" | keep incoming_tls_alert [$__range])))

panels.description: TLS alerts the load balancer received from clients during the handshake. Follows the dashboard filters.

panels.title: Requests (newest 500 lines)

targets.expr: {job=~"$job", subcommand="elb", kind="request", lb=~"$lb"} | json client_ip="client_ip", elb_status="elb_status" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | elb_status=~"$status"

panels.description: Lines shipped with --loki-time event (the serve default) are stored at the request time, so the time range selects requests. Lines shipped with --loki-time scan are stored at the scan time; the real request time is the event_time column.

panels.title: Connections (newest 500 lines)

targets.expr: {job=~"$job", subcommand="elb", kind="conn", lb=~"$lb"} | json client_ip="client_ip" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip"

panels.description: Lines shipped with --loki-time event (the serve default) are stored at the request time, so the time range selects requests. Lines shipped with --loki-time scan are stored at the scan time; the real request time is the event_time column.
